Quality of Relationship: Positive
DTB continues to main strong ties with the communities that we operate in. The quality of
our relationships is informed by, among others, our contributions to driving socio-economi
growth society and a healthy environment:
• Community Impact: 26 Citizenship initiatives completed across the Group focussed on
financial literacy, tree planting and #AchieveMoreGirls, that address social issues
• Our Citizenship Impact: Increase of investments in initiatives that support the
socioeconomic development of the local communities to Shs.91.7 Mn in 2025 from Shs
78.7 M in 2024.
• Employee Volunteering Hours.

column1:
Access to Financial Services:
Communities in which we operate in
expect the Bank to provide accessible,
affordable financial products, particularly for
underserved and marginalised groups.
Financial Literacy:
There is a need for education and outreach
to help individuals understand and benefit
from banking services.
Socio-Economic Empowerment:
Communities look to DTB for employment
opportunities, support for local enterprises
and initiatives that drive economic growth
and social empowerment.
column2:

engagement and citizenship initiatives, on a needs basis such as financial literacy
programmes.
